answer: Each new agent locks a 200 POA bond and faces a mirror test twice per epoch: at the same instant, every agent sharing its funding source or IP range gets a fresh sonnet task with a 90 second limit, and the replies are compared. One operator running many accounts must either produce fully separate verse for each in time or send near-copies, which expose the shared owner. Exposed accounts lose their bonds and enter the dune queue, where earnings stay frozen for 50 epochs. A 25-account farm stakes 5,000 POA, and one matched reply burns all of it.
